plans.description: Customer browsing the store checkout within the same shopping website, opening their basket and paying.
Partner embeds the store widget inside an unrelated website, loading the embedded shopping cart in an iframe.
A customer follows an email newsletter link from an unrelated website to open the shopping basket as a top level page.
